camel_example: aliyun avatar Create2dAvatar --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId 1 --Transparent true --Video 'https://virtual-human-assets.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/2d_assets/xxx/xxx/xxx.mov?Expires=xxx&OSSAccessKeyId=REDACTED_ACCESS_KEY_ID&Signature=REDACTED_SIGNATURE' --Portrait 'https://virtual-human-assets.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/2d_assets/xxx/xxx/xxx.png?Expires=xxx&OSSAccessKeyId=REDACTED_ACCESS_KEY_ID&Signature=REDACTED_SIGNATURE' --Orientation 1 --Name '博远' --version 2022-01-30 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits a video of a real person to generate a corresponding 2D real-person digital human avatar. This operation immediately returns an avatar code, which can be used to query, update, or delete the avatar
description_zh: 提交一段真人视频素材生成对应的2D真人数字人形象，该接口会立即返回一个形象code，后续可以根据形象code调用查询、更新、删除人物接口
kebab_example: aliyun avatar create-2d-avatar --tenant-id 1 --name '博远' --portrait 'https://virtual-human-assets.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/2d_assets/xxx/xxx/xxx.png?Expires=xxx&OSSAccessKeyId=REDACTED_ACCESS_KEY_ID&Signature=REDACTED_SIGNATURE' --video 'https://virtual-human-assets.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/2d_assets/xxx/xxx/xxx.mov?Expires=xxx&OSSAccessKeyId=REDACTED_ACCESS_KEY_ID&Signature=REDACTED_SIGNATURE' --transparent true --orientation 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Create2dAvatar

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID obtained from the Virtual Digital Human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.example: 朝气蓬勃，富有感染力，适用于播音、传媒广电、企业宣传等场景
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the avatar thumbnail.

If this parameter is not specified, the first frame of the video is captured as the avatar thumbnail.
If this parameter is specified, the resolution must be the same as that of the original video. The format must be PNG, and the size must be less than 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
人物缩略图URL。

如果不传，将会截取视频第一帧作为人物缩略图。
如果传，要求分辨率和原视频分辨率保持一致，格式png，大小<10M
parameters.name: image

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the avatar profile picture.
Requirements: The aspect ratio must be 1:1. The format must be PNG, and the size must be less than 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
人物头像URL。
要求：尺寸1:1，格式png，大小<10M
parameters.name: portrait

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the original video material. Requirements:

The format must be MOV, WebM, or MP4. WebM is recommended for transparent videos.
The video duration must be 5 to 10 minutes.
The resolution must be 1080p.
The size must be less than 10 GB
parameters.help_zh:
原始视频素材URL，要求：

格式mov、webm、mp4，针对透明视频格式推荐webm
视频时长5-10分钟
分辨率1080p
大小<10G
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the original video material is transparent. Valid values:
true: The video is in a transparent format and supports background replacement.
false: The video is in a non-transparent format and does not support background replacement
parameters.help_zh:
原始视频素材是否是透明

true：透明格式，可支持替换背景
false：非透明格式，不支持替换背景
parameters.name: transparent

parameters.help_en:
The orientation of the original video. Valid values:
1: Portrait.
2: Landscape
parameters.help_zh:
原始视频方向：横竖屏

1: 竖屏
2: 横屏
parameters.name: orientation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether an event callback is required when the 2D avatar generation node is successful or failed. Default value: false, which indicates that no callback is triggered. References: Digital human callback event notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.help_zh: 本次2D形象生成任务成功或失败是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。具体可参考文档：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.name: callback

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
